notes.title: Ver1.200 アップデート
notes.content:
Hello!
We would like to inform you that we have updated "Hazy Monochrome Wand".
The update contents of Ver1.200 are as follows.
--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[list]
[*] [h3]Addition of hard mode[/h3]
[/list]
Added hard mode for users who have completed the game.
You can play games with increased memory level caps and difficulty levels!

Currently, there are 5 levels of hard mode.
You can increase the level by one each time you clear it.
Although it is a very difficult mode, the upper limit level of memory increases,
You should be able to play the game with a new feeling.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3][list]
[*] Added 5 new memories
[/list][/h3]
The following five new memories will appear.

[list]
[*] An explosion occurs when an enemy is defeated.
[*] The number of clocks used when "rewinding time" will be reduced.
[*] Shots now track enemies.
[*] Additional keys may be placed on the stage.
[*] Time stagnation is strengthened.
[/list]

-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[list]
[*] [h3] Time Stagnation Enhancement[/h3]
[/list]
The strength of this game is "time stagnation",
It seems that some users said, ``I don't feel like it's slowing down that much.''

Therefore, "time stagnation" is strengthened,
All times except PL are now slightly slower.

This may make the game a little easier, but
Hard mode has also been added, so be sure to give it a try along with this update!

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Other minor bugs have also been fixed.

Thank you for using "Hazy Monochrome Wand".

notes.title: Ver1.100 update
notes.content:
Hello!
We would like to inform you that we have updated "Hazy Monochrome Wand".

The update contents of Ver1.100 are the following two points.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3][list]
[*] Block with time limit
[/list][/h3]

A breakable block that rarely appears during the stage,
Valuable items appear when destroyed.

If you can find
Please destroy it by using magic that slows down time.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

[h3][list]
[*] Adjustment of jump power
[/list][/h3]
Adjusted the jump force when pressing the jump button for a short time.
This should make jump adjustments easier.

It shouldn't affect the behavior when you press it for a long time,
If you are used to the old behavior, please note that the behavior has changed slightly.


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

It also fixes some minor bugs.

Thank you for using "Hazy Monochrome Wand".

notes.title: About future updates
notes.content:
Hello!
Thank you for playing "Hazy Monochrome Wand"!
If you haven't played it, I'd be happy if you could take this news as an opportunity to play it!

This time, I would like to report about the future "Hazy Monochrome Wand".

▼ As the current update contents, we are planning to take the following measures.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[h3][list]
[*] Fix bugs as soon as they are found
[/list][/h3]
For the release, I did a bug check with my friend,
Annoying bugs have been removed as much as possible.

However, I think there are probably some bugs that occur at rare timings.
We will fix this as soon as we find it.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
[list]
[h3][*] Added stages for each zone
[*] Addition of special challenging rooms
[*] Add Synergistic Memories[/h3]
[/list]
Even now, I think that this game is a game that you can enjoy until the ending.
I think it's also true that it's possible to add more fun stages.

Therefore, in order to improve replayability and play with a fresher feeling,
[u][b]Stages and enhancement elements will be added[/b][/u].

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- ---------
[h3][list]
[*] Added hard mode for clear users
[/list][/h3]
This game does not implement "hard mode" in Ver1.00 because the difficulty of the basic rules is high.
However, for users who were able to clear in the future,
[u][b]We are thinking of adding a more challenging "hard mode"[/b][/u].

After checking the progress of the user,
We are planning to release the one with the difficulty adjusted.
(It's sure to be a very difficult mode, though.)

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
We will update the above elements as soon as they are available for release.
And we are considering adding them while listening to the opinions of the players.
Therefore, we are always looking for opinions.
(However, please be gentle!)

Please enjoy "Hazy Monochrome Wand"!
